resources.string: Plan and equipment do not match
Resistance percentages describe the device range. Copy and adapt the plan to your effort; automatic resistance requires supported equipment.
Focus on stroke rate and smooth technique. Set resistance on the rower to suit your effort. Copy the plan to adjust rate ranges and durations.
Speed and incline are manual guidance. Copy and adapt them to your comfortable gait. Recording never starts the treadmill or changes speed or incline.
The 10-minute interval is a short block. Warm up beforehand and cool down gradually afterwards; separate warm-up and cool-down plans are available.
Bars show sampled peaks per time interval; missing intervals remain empty.
